verdict.rationale: An inference API provider could plausibly accept remote MCP servers as tools, for example through a Responses-style API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents generic tool calls and compatibility with the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, with no mention of MCP server support. Function calling is a developer building block, and connecting Claude Code or Codex to Munito is the reverse direction, so neither counts as an MCP-client capability.
